I understand the thought behind it and I do agree that there should be more security. 
However, please consider whitelisting mods or working closer to MelonLoader. There are certain functions that make the game easier to access and most are harmless.

For example: AMD FSR should be an expectation. Not everyone has a good enough computer to play without it.

comments.value: Maybe FSR could also work on Quest/ Android standalone and drastically improve performance, if it could be implemented... should still give us the option on PC to do it regardless of "might not work with all shaders"

Seconded, I think that after this whole EAC situation too this was taken away as an option for us to mod it into the game ourselves a while ago, it's only fair that we should be able to implement amd and other drivers features into our experience right?
This NEEDS to be in VRChat. It's pratically impossible for the devs to really improve performance anymore, I imagine, so adding FSR 2.2 or similar that works universally is basically a NEED

mentionedUsers.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: They could probably just make it so that the FSR mod or even VRPerf Kit RSF mod can be installed without EAC blocking it.
I do not consent. FSR is a short term solution for poorly optimized content and wron't solve the real issue.
@{60c0e22718009c104862d5bc|full_name} This is the wrong perspective to take. FSR helps all users no matter how well or badly a game is optimized.
@{64dc41752be0c991ddfe9e38|full_name}, VRChat is heavily CPU bound. FSR won’t help in 99% of real world low FPS scenarios, even on Quest.
@{60c0e22718009c104862d5bc|full_name} On what CPU's? It doesn't hit my 5800x much at all. It's the GPU and vram usage that gets slammed. FSR would help for GPU bottlenecks.

@{64dc41752be0c991ddfe9e38|full_name} I have a 5700X3D. But do you know that the main thread of VRChat is single-threaded? That means most of the game rendering is limited to one core. 

Secondly, FSR will not help with VRAM usage. If you load a bunch of poorly optimized avatars, they will consume VRAM, and that's just expected.

What is your GPU usage with VSync disabled? This is the only factor that actually tells if you are CPU limited or not. If your GPU usage is not maxed out, then FSR will be useless.

@{60c0e22718009c104862d5bc|full_name} Yes that's what single threaded means. Unfortunately this game is far more vram and GPU bottlenecks. Again, that would helped to some degree with for. Why do you not want others to have better performance in VRC? 

Again, my cousin is barely hit. It's my 4070ti usage and vram that gets slammed.

@{64dc41752be0c991ddfe9e38|full_name} If your game isn't smooth with a 4070 Ti, then I am afraid to tell you that FSR isn't the solution you are looking for. Do you mind me asking a screenshot of your GPU usage when you have low FPS ?

@{60c0e22718009c104862d5bc|full_name} FSR will help. Stop denying the facts at hand. No matter how many optimization tips and videos I have watched nothing will help this game like FSR can. 

GPU usage is always in the upper 90s along with vram being at 10.5gb often.
To make the most of it, add an option for AMD FidelityFX CAS this would help mitigate the blurring introduced by FSR.

mentionedUsers.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: @{60c0e22718009c104862d5bc|full_name} While I understand your perspective (also a 5700X3D user), there are a lot of scenarios where I run into GPU bottlenecks, even with a 3080. FSR would be another option for people to at least *try to solve* solve performance issues. It also has the chance to allow users to enable certain GPU/shader features that they wouldn't be able to otherwise, since they can reduce some GPU load and use FSR to re-sharpen it.

@{62df013246e66844a84a8ef1|full_name} this post is 5 years old, and I do still believe that FSR/DLSS is a bad design choice, especially for a game like VRChat. People shouldn't rely on it as a magic "improve performance" button. If a world has GPU optimization issues, it's up to the world creator to make it work well for most GPUs out there. But with 1.1k upvotes, it's most likely that they will add this feature soon.

details: FSR released today and it's a clear and obvious benefit to everyone that it be available on as many games as possible. VRChat can broaden accessibility and ease performance issues with FSR. Please get to work implementing it. It's apparently so easy a dev sat down and put it in their game in a couple of hours.
title: Impliment AMD FSR as soon as possible.
